Hi Jonas / Monica —

I need to escalate a sensitive matter that came to my attention this morning. A contractor who supports my team, Samira Khan (samira.khan@vendorco.com), reported that after a recent performance conversation with her direct manager, she experienced a series of schedule changes and removal from critical meetings that she believes are retaliatory. She is asking for confidentiality and is worried that raising this will jeopardize her work with our team.

Key points: 
- Samira says the behavior began after she shared concerns in a 1:1 about workload (dates: 2026-05-05 to 2026-05-12).
- She identified one manager by name in the intake call; I’ve not copied that person on this thread.
- She requested an intake call with HR and asked that I not share details with her manager before HR speaks with her.

Actions I’ve taken so far:
- Paused any staffing or role changes for the contractor pending HR review.
- Preserved calendar invites and Slack messages (I’ve downloaded the thread and attached a summary).

Please advise next steps. I can schedule an intake call for tomorrow morning if that helps; Samira prefers a remote meeting but is flexible.

Thanks —
Laura
